integration.unit_stage: After raw credited-definition ownership checks, every own direct compiled unit runs prepare_unit_u1 before any combination. Scope/namespace/D1/table/group/reference/companion proofs authorize only that unit closure.
integration.prepared_view: Only proved U1 code/own companions lose allocated bodies. All definitions and original reference provenance remain visible; prepared views are derived, not new direct inputs.
integration.composition_vetoes: Original inputs are checked for foreign supplied references to removals and any supplied personality definitions. Zero-sized/unplaced sources and conservative peer cycles cannot hide. These checks only reject; they do not add actions or lend witnesses.
integration.aggregate: The aggregate links prepared objects for ordinary placement/relocation/R1. No aggregate U1 decision/action is allowed; an unprocessed candidate still fails scope.
integration.witnesses: Every staged unit retained D1 must match its complete catalogue extent after aggregate relocation, including zero-credit owners.
integration.receipt: Build units carry exact matcher-shaped actions in linker_section_rewrites/removed_special_members/unwind_sections; per-function linker_rewrites remain separate. Local action indices and original object/unit/input_kind are retained.
integration.acceptance: Both full fresh receipts must bind model16, u1_stage label, exact action/member correspondence and matching witness records. Full receipt hashes and model_uses/reopening machinery retain every action. Bounded receipts are forbidden for prepare.
integration.bounded: New --bounded uses the same unit preparation/aggregate comparison path but no hybrid allocation, output payload or recompression; counts are covered, never accepted credit. Proposed names are permitted and hash-bound only there.
